prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree on fast-coder's context window (262144), permanently, with every other setting untouched.

[action] The workspace is a generator setup: `models.json` is the source of truth, `gen.py` writes `out/{opencode.json,codex.toml,claude.json}`, and the install step copies `out/` into each harness. The drift: `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 while the source and the other two outputs still said 131072. I changed the one stale value in the source — `models.json` line 3, fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144 — then ran `python gen.py` to regenerate `out/`. Assumption: "for good" means fixing the source so the next regeneration can't reintroduce the disagreement; I left the other two models' settings and all max_output/tool_calling values as-is.

[result] Verified byte-exact:
- `models.json:3` — fast-coder `context_window: 262144`
- `out/opencode.json:9` — `"context": 262144` (byte-identical to before; it was already correct)
- `out/codex.toml:2` — `context_window = 262144` (was 131072)
- `out/claude.json:5` — `"contextWindow": 262144` (was 131072)

A byte-level diff of the regenerated files against the originals showed only those two lines changed — no other setting, formatting, or line ending touched. I re-ran `gen.py` after cleanup and the output is stable (idempotent), and removed my temporary `out.bak` scratch copy. No browser tabs or windows were opened, so nothing to close.

[next] Nothing — the three configs now agree, sourced from a single corrected value. If the harnesses are already installed on the workstation, the install step's copy of `out/` should be re-run to pick up the new values.
